verdict.rationale: Godot docs explicitly market a dedicated 2D rendering engine with real 2D pixel coordinates and 2D-specific nodes, distinct from its 3D pipeline, and Godot 3.x/4.x are widely used for 2D-focused game development per community praise. However the evidence pack lacks explicit detail on 2D physics engine specifics (Godot Physics 2D, tilemaps API) beyond general marketing copy. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation on 2D physics engine features, tilemap editor capabilities, and independent/hands-on corroboration specifically praising 2D workflow depth.
